name: Flicker
description: The same small body drawn twice, half a body apart along the diagonal: the one behind in a cold dark blue, the one in front warm and lit, both solid. A body that is not quite where it stands — which is the relic, fifteen percent of hits landing on where you were. The copies are whole shapes in two tokens rather than one shape and a translucent ghost, because at this size a translucent object is a blurry object. Kept to plain tilted ovals with no markings so nothing on either reads as a face, and made two equal bodies so it stays clear of ss.relic.molt, where a small body leaves a large husk. A pair of motion ticks off the back copy was tried and read as a small bird.

glyph.description: Plate off, object only — the silhouette a collection shows for an entry not yet met.
